FrameSamples.TimingScopes: All timing fields are CPU wall-clock milliseconds. ElapsedMs retains the original whole-frame boundaries. PrepareMs, ReconcileMs, ExecuteMs, GameUpdateWaitMs, FrameSlotAcquireMs, AcquireImageMs and PresentMs are disjoint intervals within that frame. FrameSlotAcquireMs covers TryOpenNextFrame, including completed-work collection, slot selection/waits and reset; it is not a pure GPU wait. GraphExecuteMs and CompletionWaitMs are nested inside ExecuteMs, not additional frame costs. GraphExecuteMs covers RenderGraphFrame.Execute (analysis, recording and submission). CompletionWaitMs covers only an already-requested synchronous/output-readback completion wait. OtherFrameMs is ElapsedMs minus the seven disjoint intervals, never minus the nested fields. It includes remaining event/UI/setup/scheduling/cleanup work and is not GPU elapsed time.
FrameSamples.Sampling: Default: original warmup and wall-clock sample. Explicit MeasurementFrames: the requested zero-based simulation frames, without retiming or replacing failed frames. Each sample records its SimulationFrame.

Report.Timing: Presented frame elapsed time and CPU-side stage elapsed time; GPU duration is not measured
Report.ShadowResolutionSampling: Completed asynchronous bias feedback received during the timed sample window; feedback may lag presented frames. No end-of-window GPU wait. Empty feedback has null bias statistics.
